text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I ran so much that my legs feel like 
lead..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's it for practice today, right? 
Thanks for your hard work~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sei-chan! Are you already done with 
training for today?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right~. How about you, 
Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I think I'll keep at it a bit longer. 
I just can't seem to get the hang of when 
to make my move...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"You shouldn't push yourself too hard. 
Practicing blindly won't yield any 
results, after all."
choice_data_list:
Why not keep her company for a 
side-by-side run?

True, taking care of your body is 
important too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I'd feel bad accepting that. Sei-chan 
was just about to head home.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Guess I have no choice, sure. 
Spe-chan is my friend, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaah, yay! Thank you, Sei-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, but only after taking a short break...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's hurry up, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: W-Wait—!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All riiight, let's give it our all 
together~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let go of me, it's not like I'm gonna run 
away! Ah, well, I will run during our 
training match, but...

Afterward, the two poured themselves into 
training right up until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm. I think we should call it a day 
now~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The next race is coming up soon, after 
all... Maybe I should call it a day, just 
like the two of them said.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let's head back together then, 
Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I don't really have anything else to 
do after this today anyway.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ I kinda wanna stop by somewhere. Like 
a restaurant with a giant food challenge—
(Grrr~)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fine then. I'll come with you to that 
shop you like, Spe-chan~.

After stopping by a shop with Special 
Week, Seiun Sky headed back home.
